# Bandra Skin & Hair Clinic

> Dermatology & hair clinic in Bandra West, Mumbai (PIN 400050). Consultation by an MD dermatologist. Fixed consultation fees, per-session prices and clear treatment plans — no surprises.

## Who we are
Bandra Skin & Hair Clinic is a Dermatology & hair clinic in Bandra West, Mumbai. 5 minutes from Bandra railway station and 10 minutes from the Bandra-Worli Sea Link. Landmark: Silver Spring building on SV Road.
Treatments are led by Dr. Sneha Rao, MD Dermatology, Fellowship in Aesthetic Medicine.

## FAQ (short answers)
Q: How many sessions will I need?
A: It depends on the problem. Acne usually needs 4–6 peels. Pigmentation takes 4–8 sessions. Laser hair removal needs 6–8 sessions spaced 4–6 weeks. Your doctor gives you a number at the first consultation.

Q: Is it safe for dark Indian skin?
A: Yes. We choose peels and laser settings for Fitzpatrick IV–V skin — the safest approach for Indian skin tones.

Q: Will it scar?
A: No. These treatments are designed to heal the skin. When a mole or wart is removed, we take extra care to minimise marks.

Q: Is there any downtime?
A: Light peels flake for 2–3 days. Medium peels need 3–5 days of heal time. Laser hair removal has no downtime.

Q: When will I see results?
A: Pigmentation starts fading in 4–8 weeks. Hair gets thicker in 3–6 months with PRP. Your doctor sets a realistic timeline at the start.

Q: Can I wear makeup after a peel?
A: Wait 24 hours after light peels. We give written after-care with everything you need to know.
